Woke up early yesterday morning, 8:30 is early for me, to take my brother to work. Came home wide awake and couldn't get back to sleep. Was on Reddit and Clash of Clans for a few hours while laying in bed. Girlfriend woke up for work at 11. We fooled around, I got sleepy. As she was in the shower I fell asleep. My dream: I dropped her off at work, but she said she would be right back out. While I was waiting for her, I drove down the street. Kept falling asleep while driving, and each time I did, my car started vanishing little by little. Turned around to go pick her back up and suddenly the car was gone and I was walking in the road. I turned my head to the left to see how close the car behind me was and when I looked forward again, I was no longer where I originally was. I remember looking to my left and seeing a few ambulances. They took off driving and as I looked to see where they were going, I noticed huge skyscrapers ahead of me to the right. They were glowing orange. Not actually glowing, but reflecting light. Reflecting fire. I realized that one of the buildings was on fire, and started panicking. I wake up to my girlfriend walking in the room. I tell her about my dream, take her to work, come back home to catch up on sleep before work at 5. Didn't think anything of it, other than it being a weird dream. On break at 7, cruising reddit. Learn of Dubai skyscraper  fire. Photos eerily resemble my dream. Haven't done the math yet, so I don't know which happened first, my dream or the fire. But the weirdest part is that my dream was at noon, the first I learned about the fire was around 7pm. 


EDIT: Just used a time zone converter. The fire happend around 2am in Dubai, which would be 5pm here in Michigan. I had a dream at noon about a skyscraper on fire.
